scope: 128-row equality AIR and 2048-row twelve-key empty recursion; zero user transactions.
timing_scope: Successful block_v2_registered_program elapsed_ns measures witness generation and the prover call. Process timings include initialization, registration, independent CPU reference work, serialization and verification.
design: Same binary, circuits, public inputs, four Rayon threads and service limits. CPU uses cpu-required policy with all GPU flags disabled. GPU uses compatible policy with all supported prototype paths selected. Each fixture/arm has one warm-up and five measured process runs, with rotating backend order.
limitations: Small diagnostic fixtures; no wallet proving, transaction-bearing recursion, or delivered throughput measurement.
Strict GPU-only stage coverage remains incomplete.
No CPU/GPU claim for larger workloads or the historical 64-input run.
Proof randomness is fresh on every proof. No attempt is made to match random grinding effort.
A new process does not imply a cold driver cache; compilation is excluded.
Stage timings overlap and are not an additive wall-time breakdown.
Peak RSS is child-process accounting; physical GPU memory peaks are not sampled.
